Holesail 0.2.1 moves to HyperDHT 0.6.0 for the recent connection, relay, reconnect and shutdown improvements. Its libuv 1.51.0, libsodium 1.0.22 and libudx `759bf764` sources now match the transport release.

Server startup also prints a terminal QR code for opening the connection in the official Holesail app. Existing connection links and CLI options stay the same.

The x86-64 and ARM64 Linux downloads are fully static single binaries. Make the downloaded file executable and run it; checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
